STATUS_EXPLANATIONS.CONSUMER_BINDING: Only dependency-name selector exists. No exact current source/native projection is attached to this END input
STATUS_EXPLANATIONS.CONSUMER_DEFINITION: END experiment acceptance case and ordered interface declaration exist; it is not a native Action/input-slot API
STATUS_EXPLANATIONS.CURRENTNESS: Binding currentness cannot pass while the current binding is absent; source age alone is not staleness
STATUS_EXPLANATIONS.LINEAGE: Actual source contexts are known and remain distinct. This is not a requirement that every component adopt one lineage
STATUS_EXPLANATIONS.PROCESS_BINDING: No current concrete process/input/reader invocation manifest for this declared interface
STATUS_EXPLANATIONS.PROCESS_DEFINITION: Contract-level projection/runner/comparison obligation exists; no native process entity required
STATUS_EXPLANATIONS.PROVENANCE: Existing sources/result/native selectors have pinned provenance; missing interface relation is not fabricated from them
STATUS_EXPLANATIONS.SCOPE: Known E2 qualification-only scope and selected composite decision are recorded; no binding authority is inferred from a source hash
STATUS_EXPLANATIONS.SOURCE_DEFINITION: Declarative canonical fixture/capability/oracle interface exists and is retained at its qualified scope
STATUS_EXPLANATIONS.SOURCE_INSTANCE: Existing qualified native/fixture source instances are present; existence does not establish exact current END operands
